title: Just the rumour of a bug is enough to find an exploit these days
summary: This article discusses how modern security research has evolved to the point where even a rumor or hint about a bug can trigger rapid vulnerability discovery and exploitation, highlighting the interconnected nature of today's security community and the speed of information propagation.
problem_solved: Examines how the security community can quickly find and weaponize exploits from minimal information about potential vulnerabilities.
why_valuable: Provides valuable insights into the current state of security research culture and the challenges of responsible disclosure in an era of instant information sharing.
